svg.aria-label: Animation: a message snaps into numbered words. Four plain-English asks pop in. One request goes to Jev and returns in 490 milliseconds, and all four answers land together: the name, the company and the email light up on the numbered words with their offsets, and the phone number is reported as not in the text.

g.text: Hi, I'm Maya Chen from Fern Labs. Reach me at maya@fern.example
Ask for anything, in plain English
Every value is copied from the message: text.slice(start, end) === value
